req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers DELETE /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 204. Examining the source, the actual endpoint is DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (the route uses squad_number as the natural key). Tests must cover: (1) positive - delete an existing player returns 204 and the player is gone; (2) negative - delete a non-existent player returns 404; (3) boundary - delete the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) in the pre-loaded set; (4) state transition - after deletion, a subsequent GET confirms absence; (5) decision table - server error path when delete_by_squad_number_async returns False. The endpoint uses squad_number as the path parameter, so all tests target /players/squadnumber/{n}. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (204, 404, 500), exact response body absence after deletion, and both sides of the existence check.

tests.name: test_delete_player_server_error_returns_500
preconditions: delete_by_squad_number_async is patched to return False to simulate DB failure
trace: R-PLAYER-014: error pathway HTTP 5xx on server error
DT: when retrieve succeeds but delete fails, route raises HTTP 500
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
from schemas.player_schema import Player
from uuid import UUID
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_server_error_returns_500():
    fake_player = Player(
        id=UUID('692f2ab9-8aec-4001-a008-0ba06d53ba0a'),
        first_name='Priya', last_name='Chopra',
        squad_number=15, position='Left-Back'
    )
    with patch('services.player_service.retrieve_by_squad_number_async',
               new=AsyncMock(return_value=fake_player)), \
         patch('services.player_service.delete_by_squad_number_async',
               new=AsyncMock(return_value=False)):
        r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert r.status_code == 500

test_delete_player_server_error_returns_500()

tests.name: test_delete_player_removes_from_collection
preconditions: 26 players pre-loaded; player with squad_number=20 exists
actions: GET /players/ to record count before deletion
GET /players/ to record count after deletion
trace: R-PLAYER-014: player is deleted from the system
STC: collection size transitions from N to N-1 after delete
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_removes_from_collection():
    r_before = client.get('/players/')
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    count_before = len(r_before.json())
    r_delete = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/20')
    assert r_delete.status_code == 204
    r_after = client.get('/players/')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    count_after = len(r_after.json())
    assert count_after == count_before - 1

test_delete_player_removes_from_collection()
